items.q: We’re partners with Harvard and Jay Winsten in the medical department.

ctx.x: you, you will have goose bumps the time you get off the plane until the time you leave. Total Angolan influence and the merger of the most powerful African culture and lyricism of Portuguese and African, like you’d never heard in your life, and it never stops. It will make beehives grow on your booty. I’m telling you. Nobody – you can’t – you won’t believe it. I go every year, and I’m blown away after seeing it 54 years. Don’t – let’s not talk – but they know how to do it all, from cachaza, [?katarenyo] – that’s…

made [$]63-million. We pitched the government to send [$]800-million. But that’s nothing like this. Bono was shocked too, because the same with Live Aid. We did everything we could, but this thing just ran by that. Bono told me last week that he’s going – they’re going to do – [Nicholas] Sarkozy’s going to do, [Bl?] and the president [?] going to give him a billion euro for African farmers. Bono is one of the smartest men I ever met in my life. We [are] partners in crime on some things. He’s got data. I’ve got my…
Oh yes. The guy’s got all those kids.
